resources.name: Open-source DMFT solver with exact diagonalization impurity solver

access.notes: Any DMFT implementation that includes an ED impurity solver (e.g., TRIQS, pomerol, or a self-written ED code) is acceptable.
Experimental rutile structure (space group P4₂/mnm) with lattice parameters a=4.421 Å, c=2.918 Å and atomic positions available in common crystallographic databases.
